title: Pediatric Eustachian Tube Dilatation in the Management of Mesotympanic Retraction With Effusion.
official: Pediatric Eustachian Tube Dilatation in the Management of Mesotympanic Retraction With Effusion: a Multicenter Randomized Study Versus Standard Treatment.
summary: The goal of this clinical investigation is to evaluate the effectiveness of ETD + standard treatment versus standard treatment only, on the improvement of the tympanic membrane retraction, up to 18 months after intervention in children aged \]8-17\[ with posterior mesotympanic retraction and middle ear effusion.
conditions: Chronic Otitis Infections in pédiatric Patients
Retraction Pocket of the Tympanic Membrane

interventions.name: Eustachian tube dilation added to standard treatment

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Children aged strictly between 8 and 17 years of age
* Presenting a posterior mesotympanic retraction (grade II or III without adherence to the promontory from Sade's grade) with effusion

Exclusion Criteria:

* Weight strictly less than 20kg
* Down syndrome
* Craniosynostosis and other head and neck malformations
* History of skull base surgery
* History of skull fracture
* Failure to obtain consent
* Non-affiliation to a social security scheme
* Persons placed under legal protection
* Person participating in another research including a period of exclusion still in progress
